name: Tactiq
description: Search, read, and summarise meeting transcripts and summaries from Google Meet, Zoom, and Microsoft Teams - directly from Claude. Meetings as context: ask what was decided, who you spoke with, or what’s come up across any call. Your entire meeting history, answerable.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Tactiq to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Tactiq to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.tactiq.io/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Tactiq MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tactiq provides these MCP tools: expand_transcript_excerpt, get_generation_status, get_meeting, get_meeting_artifact, get_transcript, get_transcript_excerpts, list_meeting_artifacts, list_recent_meetings, and search_meetings.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Tactiq?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Tactiq in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Tactiq requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Tactiq is developed by Tactiq. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
